To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the novel pH-sensitive GFP derivative eGFP-pHisens can be used for highly accurate and spatially resolved measurements of the intracellular cytosolic and mitochondrial matrix pH in living CHO-K1 cells with high precision.
we developed a highly sensitive fluoroprobe for pH imaging by fluorescence lifetime imaging with high spatial and temporal resolution.
eGFP-pHSens is a very sensitive pH probe that can be targeted to different subcellular organelles in mammalian cells.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the development and application of a novel FLIM setup for the simultaneous determination of fluorescence lifetime and amplitude ratio images of eGFP and its variants with a time resolution of below one hundred picoseconds.

the development of novel fluorescent probes for pH measurements and the establishment of new experimental approaches for the determination of intracellular pH with high precision and spatial resolution.

the development of a novel pH-sensitive fluorescent probe (eGFP-PHsens), its application for the determination of pH in intracellular compartments and its potential for the investigation of the activity of proton channels in the plasma membrane.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
eGFP-pHpHsens is an excellent tool for pH determination with high precision and spatial resolution in the cell cytosol or in mitochondria of mammalian cells.
the pH-sensitized eGFP is a highly useful fluorophore for the determination of intracellular pH by FLIM with excellent spatial resolution.
eGFP-pHisens is a very promising fluorophore for the determination of pH in intracellular compartments by FLIM.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the pH-sensitive GFP (eGFPpHsens) is a highly useful fluorophore for pH imaging with FLIM.
the pH-sensing eGFP-pHSens is an excellent fluorophore for pH imaging in cells by FLIM.
eGFP-pHisens is an excellent pH-sensitive probe for FLIM, that can be targeted to specific cellular compartments and is highly sensitive for pH changes in the cytoplamic range.
The main takeaway from our work is that
eGFP-pHSens is a very useful fluorophore for FLIM-based measurements of cellular pH with high spatial resolution.
FLIM of eGFP-based pH sensors can be applied for the precise and accurate determination of the intracellular and intramitochondrial pH with high temporal and spatial resolution.
FLIM is a powerful tool to measure intracellular pH in living cells and that the pH-sensor eGFP-pHpHsens provides excellent precision and accuracy in this context.
